title: pvSplineSource
body:
## pvSplineSource

Creates a smooth curve through control points: a parametric spline (ParametricFunction "Spline", with its own Points and Closed options) tessellated into a polyline of Resolution points. Use it for smooth seed or probe paths and annotation curves; pvPolyLineSource joins the points with straight segments instead.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The spline interpolates the control points, so it can overshoot between widely spaced points; add control points to keep it in place.
- Schemaxis generates this source from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for it, so inspect the output before relying on it.

Native constructor: `SplineSource`. Identity: `sources/SplineSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ParametricFunction` | Property used to reference the parametric function as data generator. | `{"type":"typed proxy","choices":["Spline"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `{"type":"Spline"}` |
| `Resolution` | Set the spline resolution. | `{"minimum":2,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `2` |

### Nested `ParametricFunction` → `Spline`

Syntax: `{"type":"Spline","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `parametric_functions/Spline`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ParametricFunction.options.Closed` | When true, the spline forms a continuous loop, joining the last control point smoothly back to the first; when false it is an open curve from the first to the last point. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ParametricFunction.options.Points` | Control points as a flat list [x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2, …] in dataset units. The curve passes through each point in the listed order, so order matters and the list length must be a multiple of 3 (at least two points). Complete tuples of 3 values. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,

```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvSplineSource"
}
```
